```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 548 - GODMODE ALL STARTS EVERY HUNT BY ITSELF (Ground: job 545 printed the godmode body, and its armed count only switches on powers already narrowed, so a press with only fly ready never starts the health or ammo hunts. No game relaunch rides this job. Every variable carries the p548 prefix.) ==='
$p548b64 = ''
$p548patcher = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch548.cs'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p548patcher, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p548b64))
$p548src = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal3.cs'
$p548tmp = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal3.p548.cs'
$p548verdict = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch548.verdict.txt'
$p548csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
& $p548csc /nologo /out:'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch548.exe' $p548patcher
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'PATCHER BUILD FAILED' } else {
  & 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch548.exe' $p548src $p548tmp $p548verdict
  $p548v = ''
  if (Test-Path $p548verdict) { $p548v = Get-Content $p548verdict }
  Write-Output ('VERDICT ' + $p548v)
  if ($p548v -eq 'PATCH OK') {
    & $p548csc /nologo /target:winexe /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll /out:'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.p548.exe' $p548tmp
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'CSC FAILED - LIVE FILES UNTOUCHED' } else {

      Copy-Item $p548tmp $p548src -Force
      Copy-Item 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.p548.exe' 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe' -Force
      $p548old = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
      foreach ($p548o in $p548old) { Stop-Process -Id $p548o.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
      $p548still = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
      if ($p548still.Count -eq 0) {
        $p548new = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe' -PassThru
        Write-Output ('TERMINAL LAUNCHED pid=' + $p548new.Id)
      } else { Write-Output 'OLD STILL RUNNING - NEW EXE READY, NO LAUNCH' }
      $p548exe = Get-Item 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe'
      Write-Output ('EXE BYTES=' + $p548exe.Length + ' WRITE=' + $p548exe.LastWriteTime)
    }
  } else { Write-Output 'PATCH HELD - LIVE FILES UNTOUCHED' }
}
```
